title: IVG Pro 12 Fizzy Orange Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Fizzy Orange IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods capture the taste of sweet Orange lifted by a lively soda-style sparkle. Zesty citrus notes bring a bright top layer, while a gentle confectionery sweetness rounds the profile for a refreshing, easy-going vape. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Click the two together and the system automatically tops up the pod as you vape — no refills or coil changes required. A mesh coil provides consistent flavour and smooth MTL vapour, and the secure click-fit assembly keeps setup simple and tidy. Compatible exclusively with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
